vacantBand.heading: Own a home that's sat empty too long?
vacantBand.body: An unsold, unoccupied property doesn't just wait quietly — it keeps costing you, and it's the exact situation the "we buy houses for cash" companies are built to take advantage of. We're not that. We get the property back into sellable shape so you keep the full value of your sale.
